justification: Assessment returned INVALID but targeted line 0424/0426 (proof of Prop 'small generators'), not the ground-truth flaw (Fact at 0627-0635, the false claim that every even-dim space with nondegenerate polar form decomposes into hyperbolic pairs; witness F_3^2, q=x^2+y^2, which is anisotropic). The assessment explicitly waved that Fact through as 'standard, cited', so it did not target the same defect. Its own flaw was verified concretely and is genuine: (i) the proposition hypothesis 'q is not zero in R' (0420) and 'char(R) does not divide q' (0424) do not make q invertible (R=Z, q=2; R=Z/4, q=2), so the modified cone definition c_{b,W}=d|(q^{-k}(W-c_{b,dW})) at 0426 is not well posed under the stated hypothesis; (ii) the Cone Identity proof at 0360 explicitly uses d^2=0, which by the paper's own Claim 'delta squared' (0118-0128) requires (q+1)r=0 for all r in R, an assumption dropped here. Recomputing with the Clifford-type identity dd|-d|d=q^k gives d c_{b,W} = (W - c_{b,dW}) + q^{-k} d|(c_{b,d^2 W}); for k=2, R=Q, q=2, dim W=2, d^2 W=(q+1)*{0} so the residual is (3/4) times the sum of the binom(4,1)_q distinct 2-spaces of W_b containing b_1, which is nonzero. Hence the identity alpha = d c_{b,alpha} used at 0431 is unavailable and the chains W-c_{b,dW} are not even cycles. Both defects check out.
